title: Freestanding 4 Pivoting Swing Arm Towel Stand - 49-Inch Solid Brass Bathroom Towel Stand, Soho Collection, Allied Brass
body_html:
Keep towels organized and drying neatly without drilling into your walls—this freestanding swing arm towel stand is backed by a limited lifetime warranty and designed for everyday bathroom use.

  • Maximize space with 4 pivoting arms that swing to separate towels and reduce clutter
  • Place it anywhere—freestanding design requires no wall mounting
  • Enjoy steadier support with a heavy, weighted base that helps prevent tipping
  • Protect floors and surfaces with a felt pad designed to prevent scratching
  • Choose a look that fits—available in a wide variety of lifetime designer finishes

Built from solid brass, this towel stand is made to outlast die-cast zinc and plastic alternatives while delivering corrosion-resistant, rust-free performance. Part of the Soho collection—a clean-lined, versatile option for matching Soho and other transitional bathroom hardware.

Complete your bathroom with matching pieces from the Soho collection.
